prompt: Fixed camera. Immediately the heavy man gives the clerk's shoulder two slow pats, turns his face a little towards him and, savouring it, says in a smooth, posh English voice: "All of it." Mouth moving naturally with each word, said once. The clerk swallows, a bead of sweat sliding down his cheek, and scribbles frantically, the pen racing down the checkboxes on the "PURCHASES" clipboard, which stays legible. Behind them a couple of shoppers browse slowly; the patterned umbrella stays still. Only the heavy man speaks. Sound: his line, the scratch of a hurried pen, gentle rain, soft crowd murmur. Damp grey light, realistic.
